name: claude-channel-mux
description: Multi-channel, multi-agent room multiplexer for Claude Code and Codex CLI over Slack/Telegram.

interface.shortDescription: Route Slack and Telegram to agent sessions.
interface.longDescription: Runs a lightweight daemon that binds Slack/Telegram rooms to cwd-scoped Claude Code and Codex agent slots, with visible agent identity, lazy session startup, Agent SPI routing, Codex App Server transport, and resilient platform delivery.
defaultPrompt: Configure Slack and Telegram for channel mux.
Explain how Codex runtime mode works.
Set up a CCM orchestrator room and worker-room workflow.
